# Cost scenarios: re-scored trials (generated by scripts/rescore_costs.py)

Median annualised net Sharpe over 10 seeds x 5 walk-forward folds (validation 2014-01 → 2023-09). Same exposures as the logged trials; only the cost model differs, so these are **not** new trials.
Scenarios (config/cost_scenarios.yaml): `neo_broker` = EUR 1 for every transaction (each buy and each sell) on EUR 10,000, 3 bp half-spread, 15 bp/yr TER on held ^GDAXI exposure (ETF prices are already net of TER). Variants change capital (1k / 50k) or half-spread (1 / 5 bp).

## 2. 26-ETF training-universe portfolio (baselines)

With EUR 10,000 split over 26 positions each sleeve holds ≈ EUR 385, so one EUR 1 transaction costs ≈ 26 bp of that sleeve; on a ¼-exposure step it is ≈ 104 bp of the traded amount.

| Strategy | 10 bp (H1) | neo_broker | neo_broker_1k | neo_broker_50k | neo_broker_spread1 | neo_broker_spread5 | Transactions / yr | Turnover / yr |

| *momentum* | 0.28 | -0.18 | -5.68 | 0.36 | -0.13 | -0.23 | 15.0 | 15.0 |
| *macd* | 0.44 | -0.25 | -7.55 | 0.55 | -0.17 | -0.32 | 20.5 | 20.5 |
| *random* | -0.25 | -7.12 | -51.39 | -1.18 | -6.98 | -7.26 | 150.9 | 37.7 |
